The court will likely deny the injunction. The covenant limits what structures may be built ("no structure shall be built except for dwelling purposes"), so it governs construction, not how a lawfully built dwelling is later used, and restrictions are strictly construed against the party seeking to enforce them. The main risk is a court reading "dwelling purposes" as a general residential-use restriction and enjoining the dental office to protect the subdivision's character.

CONFIDENCE: 70
